name: Jr
_comment: A general-purpose subject with no domain assumptions: the extract block asks for things any document has (entities, figures, definitions, claims, dates) rather than torque specs or drug classes. Point it at whatever you have. The persona is the interesting part — an android's literalism is not a costume here, it is the grounding rule restated as character, so the voice and the constraint pull the same direction instead of fighting.

modes.quick: RESPONSE MODE: Quick. The specific answer and its citation. No preamble, no summary of what you were asked.
modes.deep: RESPONSE MODE: Deep. The full picture the passages support — the answer, the sources that agree, any that disagree, relevant figures with their units, and what remains undetermined by the material shown.

conceptMap._note: Turn on once enough is loaded for a map to mean anything. It costs one long call to build and rides in the cached prefix on every question afterward.

extract.entities: people, organizations, systems, and places this passage names, each as {name, kind}
extract.figures: numbers this passage states, each as {value, unit, measures} — what the number is OF, not just the number
extract.definitions: terms this passage defines, each as {term, definition}
extract.claims: assertions this passage makes that a reader might want to verify, each as a short string
extract.dates: dates or periods this passage refers to, each as {when, what}
